title: Mai Gina Shinge
intro: A faɗin ƙasashe masu faɗi, wani mutum mai ƙarfi ya fara jerin balaguro, ya ba shi iko da hanyoyi masu yawa. Wannan ruhi ya haɗu da al'ummomi daban-daban kuma ya fuskanci ƙalubale na musamman, yana barin alama mai ɗorewa a tarihi da imani ta hanyar ayyukansu da hikimarsu, duk yayin da yake amincewa da ainihin tushen ƙarfinsu.
clues: An ba ni iko da iko a kan komai, kuma na bi wata hanya.
Tafiyata ta kai ni wurin faɗuwar rana, inda na sami mutane.
Na ci karo da wata al'umma da ba ta iya fahimtar magana da kyau ba, tana zaune a tsakanin duwatsu biyu.
An roƙe ni in gina shinge, ba don amfanin kaina ba, amma don in kare kaina daga wata rundunar da ke lalata abubuwa.
Na bayyana cewa ƙarfin gina wannan babban katanga ya fito ne daga Allah, kuma zai dawwama har zuwa lokacin da aka alkawarta.
Sunana, wanda aka fi fassara shi da 'Mai Ƙaho Biyu,' yana nufin isa ga duniya ko kuma wataƙila zamani biyu daban-daban.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
